body:
Founder real-time: 'use the art direction from DEADWEIGHT 1 and use the actual real deadweight 1 sound effects for the D2 game.' New core/palette.h (DEADWEIGHT's real brand hex palette, docs/BRAND_STYLE_GUIDE.md), core/font.{h,c} (D2's first real text renderer -- the same 5x7 bitmap font DEADWEIGHT's desktop client ships, closing a named NORTHSTAR.md gap), core/sfx.{h,c} (DEADWEIGHT's actual real sound effects -- a procedural synth engine, since DEADWEIGHT has zero sample audio files anywhere; ported near-verbatim, D2-specific cues newly composed for Railgun fire/Panic Cut/Back-EMF shatter/etc in the same synthesis idiom). Live-verified via an offline-render smoke test: 15/15 cues real, non-silent, non-clipping. Integration into apps/local/main.c and apps/client/main.c deliberately held pending a concurrent background agent's in-progress combat-redesign pass on those exact files (SECTION 548), to avoid a real concurrent-edit collision. Commit DEADWEIGHT_2@12f362f.

⚓ ☃
title: D2: ported DEADWEIGHT's real brand palette/bitmap font/procedural sfx engine
